steps.content:
1:21 p.m., October 13, N.F. 112
MBCC Bureau Chief's Office
The turmoil stirred by the Bottle of Dreams is finally calming down, and you're nearly done with your tasks for the MBCC as well.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Here are all the action reports, Chief. Once you sign them, they'll be ready for archive.

options: Swing by Nightingale later to pick them up.

choices.text: Swing by Nightingale later to pick them up.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Adjutant Nightingale is out on duty today. Before she left, she specifically instructed me to keep an eye on you and ensure you're not shirking your duties or wandering off.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: ...Ah, avoiding eye contact, are we? Feeling a bit guilty, Chief?

steps.speaker: Arrest Team Captain
steps.content: Chief, an unknown Sinner has arrived at the MBCC.

options: You need shackles, right? I'm on it—

choices.text: You need shackles, right? I'm on it—

steps.speaker: Arrest Team Captain
steps.content: Uh... Not quite like that... this person isn't for capture. She's been personally escorted by the higher-ups—a VIP, actually.

steps.speaker: Arrest Team Captain
steps.content: Per the notice, <color=#fb9259>no shackles are needed</color> for her.
As you say this, a brief message pops up on your communicator—just a few simple lines.

Observer, Shalom—Sinner inspection report M-value 463, mentally stable, no evidence of Mania capabilities, non-aggressive.
The subject has served in the public sector for 8 years and is highly trusted. She'll be aiding MBCC's day-to-day and combat operations going forward.

Confirmed by the FAC, the 9th Agency, and Paradeisos, <color=#fb9259>there's no need to shackle the individual</color>.
She is your partner.

steps.speaker: Arrest Team Captain
steps.content: The subject has been escorted to the interrogation room, Chief. She's expressed a desire to speak with you.
You walk briskly into the interrogation chamber and lock eyes with the woman across the room.
A coat, gloves, a long skirt—she's almost fully covered, leaving you unsure of how to approach her. Additionally, a mysterious piece of black quartz hovers beside her.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: We should have met sooner. I went to the party at the Midsummer Night's Club as well, but unfortunately, I didn't get a chance to speak with you. You looked dazzling that night.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: It's been a long time, dear Chief.
The woman named Shalom sits in front of you, gazing at you calmly and softly with a smile on her face.
Most Sinners are tinged with an uncontrollable restlessness, a madness they can't contain, induced by the Mania. Yet, she seems different.
...Even so, there's something oddly familiar about her. Does she know you?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I've heard. After the riot, you lost much of your memory—you probably don't remember me anymore.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Given that, allow me to reintroduce myself.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Don't be nervous, I know that the riot at the Bureau disrupted your recovery and your memory may still be a bit jumbled.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You probably don't remember me anymore, do you?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I'm Shalom. I've been entrusted to assess the situation with the MBCC and the Chief. There might be something I can assist with.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I'll likely be bothering you guys for a while, ${PlayerName}.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Yes, we crossed paths at MBCC and engaged meaningfully. You made a lasting impression on me, so perhaps we could be considered more than mere acquaintances—<color=#fb9259>friends</color>, I'd like to think.
Were you, before losing your memory, "friends" with a high-ranking, unshackled Sinner?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You look a bit surprised.

options: It's rare to see a Sinner in such a high position
You're quite an unexpected "friend," wouldn't you say?

choices.text: It's rare to see a Sinner in such a high position
You're quite an unexpected "friend," wouldn't you say?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Is that so? Madam Langley of the 9th Agency is a very powerful Sinner, and given her disposition, she's never one to downplay it.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Did you, by any chance, forget about your direct superior? Be careful, she might come knocking on your door.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Yes. You're free to regard this as my own unilateral sentiment; don't sweat it. Friendships rely on shared memories and emotional bonds, so for the time being, allow me to be the keeper of our cherished recollections.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: If you choose to see me as a new colleague, that's fine too. I'm glad to make a fresh start with you.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Feel free to ask any questions, that's why I requested this "additional Interrogation."

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: It was tough to arrange this meeting, and I'd hate to see you looking so anxious.
Her lax smile seems to let through a hint of almost imperceptible resignation.
After thinking for a moment, you decide to start with something simple and point to the odd floating object next to her.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Call it Schorl; it's the latest innovation from the Black Ring Research Institute. Since I lack the ability to defend myself independently, it's been assigned to assist with protection, communication, information gathering, and analysis among other tasks.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: The enhancement materials from MBCC designed for Sinners don't really work on me. However, if I share them with Schorl, it can optimize its combat efficiency through analysis, thereby better safeguarding everyone.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: It's a reliable companion.
After being praised, the black, stone-like triangle beeps, as if eager to prove its "competence." It then morphs, projecting a formal official document into the space.
Above, you see the logos of MBCC, FAC, and the 9th Agency, along with a seal you've seen on numerous significant documents.
Not long after the conclusion of BR-001, this same seal was also present on the individual who interrogated you. You have a vague idea of its origin.
<color=#fb9259>Paradeisos</color>, a hidden sanctuary whispered about among the people of Dis, appears intimately connected to Dr. Keylan's legacy.

The official description of it remains vague, saying it is "focused on exploration and development to continue human civilization." While it generally avoids engagement with city-state life and seldom exercises clear authority, it holds substantial sway over key organizations, including the FAC and the city council.
You've had the opportunity to encounter them, but given that you weren't treated well, it's understandable that you harbor ill feelings toward these mysterious elites.

options: I'm surprised Paradeisos is even paying attention to me.
I didn't expect Paradeisos to be so invested in MBCC.

choices.text: I'm surprised Paradeisos is even paying attention to me.
I didn't expect Paradeisos to be so invested in MBCC.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I get it—you've always had a tense relationship with Paradeisos.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I don't want to hide anything from you. Yes, Paradeisos has been watching you, particularly your involvement in the two Black Ring incidents.
Monitoring? Or is it caution? Before all this, my only interaction with you was a two-week detention and interrogation.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Just admit you despise it. You're a candid person; there's no need for pretenses with me.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Aside from public misconceptions, Paradeisos isn't exactly winning any popularity contests, but they're acutely self-aware. I picked up a saying from your overworked colleagues that hits the nail on the head when it comes to describing Paradeisos's attitude:

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: "Ugh whatever, just roll with it."
As the Chief, you nearly choke. Shalom watches your reaction, a playful look in her eyes, as though she's relishing the moment, yet also genuinely pleased.
That smile vanishes in an instant.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: With your current level of clearance, I can't disclose much about the true nature of the situation. However, the stance of Paradeisos is no secret.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: From the moment of its founding, Paradeisos has been driven by a singular goal—to seek out the nearly impossible solution for preserving human civilization in the face of apocalypse. This is their unwavering commitment, and they are willing to sacrifice everything to achieve it.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: All worldly temptations hold no allure for them. In turn, they must fervently detach from worldly attachments to navigate the complexities of reality. Consequently, their actions may often appear cold and unyielding.

options: You're saying they're like the FAC?

choices.text: You're saying they're like the FAC?

steps.content: Shalom shrugs.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: The FAC is much more popular than them.

options: What about you? The observer from Paradeisos.

choices.text: What about you? The observer from Paradeisos.

steps.content: My "unfamiliar friend from the Paradeisos," and this so-called "friendly visit"... How am I to make sense of your arrival?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: This comes from their genuine regard for you, coupled with my own subtle yearning to see you again.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Paradeisos has acknowledged all your efforts to date; they need you and wish to convey this. Of course, they're aware they lack the emotional connection needed to regain your trust. That's why they've specifically sanctioned my visit.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Given our past interactions, they seem to think that a greeting from me would yield a more favorable response.
...Is this their leniency or some form of subterfuge?
As a representative of Paradeisos, what are your directives for me?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Setting aside my personal feelings and speaking from an official and rational standpoint, I want you to know this:

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Every faction has its own viewpoint, but being made up of individuals, differing perspectives and interpretations are inevitable.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You possess a force that is both potent and enigmatic, eliciting fear, hatred, or envy from people across all organizations. How you are perceived can shift at any given moment.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: So, firm up your own convictions, keep your eyes peeled, and gather all the intel you can. Seek out the force that you can wield and believe in; that's what you should be focusing on.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You're not fundamentally at odds with them. You're not the kind to incite Mania for personal gain, so you're not inherently opposed to Paradeisos. That means there's a pathway to mutual progress.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: At least, I'd hope so.
She gazes at you with unabashed openness, her words brimming with candor, leaving you somewhat at a loss for words.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Of course, I wanted to see you.
The smile blooms on her face again.

As if she had just wrapped up a monotonous job and was finally off for the weekend, Shalom leans back in her interrogation chair. It's as if she's leaning on a late-night bar counter, blissfully enjoying your long-missed companionship.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Tell me about your journeys. You've been awake for over two months now, and I've heard you've traveled far and wide, meeting all sorts of people.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You're looking healthier, more vibrant even. Word around here is you're well-liked. You've made quite a few friends, haven't you? Share with me the highs and lows, what you've gained and what concerns you.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: It's been a while. I've been wondering how you're holding up.
The ambiance in the Interrogation Room shifts, almost as if yanking you into a forgotten past that feels strangely intimate, leaving you momentarily disoriented.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Playing the humble card, are we? According to the reports, your accomplishments are far beyond just "okay."

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Alright, enough with the suspense—I've been eagerly awaiting this. Let's hear it.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Even with such a competent adjutant by your side? Heh, word has it that you're a real risk-taker, involved in some jaw-dropping exploits.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Come on, tell me—I promise, your secret's safe with me.
She couldn't help but laugh.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Wow, you're really living on the edge, aren't you? You're key to our operations; we can't afford to have you abducted.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: So, who's been audacious enough to come at you, and how did our Minos Chief pull off a clever victory?
She gently prods you on, but her eyes merely lock onto yours, filled with a tender, expectant gaze. It's as if just teasing you brings her immense joy, as if these moments are worth savoring.
...Given she'll definitely read the report later, best to keep the conversation to trivialities.
You ponder briefly, then finally break the silence.
...Upon waking, I found myself in the midst of a riot. A mysterious woman interfered with my memory Repair Program and shattered my memories. Most of the Sinners managed to escape.
We then gathered intelligence indicating she's made her way to the Syndicate...

You speak cautiously, carefully choosing your words at first. Yet, as you peel back the layers of your past, reflecting on the road you've traveled, deeper and more intricate emotions come surging forth.

I've been to many places—Syndicate, the Rust, WhiteSands, Eastside... and even the Black Rings. Life's been a relentless series of events, to be honest. I've been overwhelmed and have certainly faced my share of adversity.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Indeed... reports can make it seem straightforward, but living it is another story altogether.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: What about now, has waking up to this world dimmed its horrors for you?
...I don't know. This world remains opaque to me.
For a long while, I've been grappling with what I can do and what I should do—just staying afloat has been a monumental task.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: But you've come so far, gained a solid footing—this Bureau is your fortress now.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Not only are you secure, but you also offer sanctuary to countless others. Each Sinner draws strength from you, and along the way, many have found their salvation through your influence.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Everyone seems to put their faith in you. That's quite the achievement, wouldn't you agree?
…I'm not as impressive as you make it sound.
There are things beyond my comprehension, and things I grasp but can do nothing about.
Exposed and vulnerable, you feel a knot tighten in your chest. Fighting to maintain composure, you bow your head and shield your eyes.
I've been aided more times than I can count, some debts I'll never be able to settle. I want to give back to this city, but I don't know how.
...No one told me what to do.
You lift your gaze to meet Shalom's.

options: You said you were a friend of who I used to be.

choices.text: You said you were a friend of who I used to be.

steps.content: What kind of person was I back then? How would he have dealt with a situation like this?
steps.female_content: What kind of person was I back then? How would she have dealt with a situation like this?

steps.content: Would the outcomes be handled better?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Sigh.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I don't get many chances to see you, so it's hard to anticipate your every move. Instead, you always seem to surprise me when we meet.
As if your words have stirred a cascade of memories, she lowers her gaze and speaks softly.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>The first time</color> we crossed paths was here, earlier this year, before you lost your memory. Back then, you were a storm of raw emotions, a spectacle of pure, unfiltered feeling. Unyielding, you charged forward without a second thought.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I wasn’t around for long, but long enough to see the chaos you left in your wake—a constant thorn for the Bureau.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>The second encounter</color> was just last month, at the Midsummer Night's Club. Quite the unexpected setting—you were all dressed-up. A single glance told me it was your covert assignment garb, so I held back, not wishing to interfere. Yet, there you were, being approached by someone entirely unexpected.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: That Sinner provoked you, throwing your plans into disarray. In the past, you would've erupted in rage. Yet, in that moment, you responded with calculated grace, maintaining just a sliver of your old temper, allowing no room for them to save face.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: And <color=#fb9259>the third time</color>? That's happening right now.
Shalom looks at you with a smile.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You've become adept at playing along with my words, revealing just enough genuine emotion to gain my trust and soften my resolve. Simultaneously, you subtly fish for information, attempting to unlock aspects of your <color=#fb9259>past</color> that remain sealed off to you.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Don't get me wrong; I'm not holding it against you. In fact, I find it comforting.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: The sober world can be overwhelmingly intricate. Watching your every move through the cold detachment of those reports is nerve-wracking. Unable to be with you, all I can do is worry.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Now that we've finally met face to face, I'm at ease. You've been evolving—maturing, steadying, and deepening your thoughts. At the very least, you've become resilient enough that no one can easily break you.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Most importantly, even with all these transformations, some core aspects of you remain the same.

She rises and approaches you. Tenderly extending her fingers, she grazes the tips of yours. A moment of hesitation passes before her fingers make their way to your palm. Finally, she takes your hand, gripping it softly but assuredly.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: We've held hands like this before. I still remember the touch, just as I remember who you were back then.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You remain as unyielding as ever, going to great lengths to preserve your true self. You don't back down easily. I admire that kind of defiance.
...Is that so?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Yes.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Back to your question. You asked me if a past version of yourself would have performed better. My answer is, no.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You're always moving forward. Even the loss of memory hasn't hindered your progress; you continue your relentless journey forward. Each step you take represents the best you are capable of, right here and now.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: But I can't just trivialize your experience with applause, because the pain and loss you've endured cut deep, they are palpable, and I feel it as if it were my own.
The gloves soak in your shared warmth, as if dissolving, leaving no barriers between.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Today, I am no longer permitted to remove these gloves and feel your touch. We each have boundaries that must not be crossed, but you should sense the sentiments I hold.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: We are fated to experience loss, but as long as you continue to move forward, the ones you hold dear will inevitably reunite with you at the journey's end, amidst a celestial ocean of azure blossoms.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: And for those memories you've lost, forever beyond reach and unable to be mourned...
The grip on your hand subtly intensifies.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: ...Don't worry, even if it's a mere fragment, I'll hold it in memory for you.
You find yourself at a loss for words, as if language pales in comparison to the raw sincerity of physical expression. Strategies and schemes seem hollow next to such genuineness.

Stance, identity, intelligence, caution, even the interrogation room you find yourself in, all blur into insignificance. The enduring fatigue and loneliness that have awoken within you, the sense of drift and aimlessness when facing a bleak past, now coalesce into uncontrollable instincts.

As you lock eyes with her, your hand tightens around hers in response. Through the softness of her palm, you feel a restrained yet deep affection that leaves you yearning, desperate for her to reveal more.

options: I need to know... Please tell me...

choices.text: I need to know... Please tell me...

steps.content: Chief!
The door to the interrogation room bursts open, and you see Nightingale dash in.
An anxious expression becomes etched onto her face, gradually morphing into a form of panic you've never seen on her before and can't comprehend.
Her gaze ultimately lands on the Paradeisos "guest."

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...I didn't expect you to show up in person, ma'am. There's an urgent document requiring Chief's authorization; could you spare a few minutes?
A palpable, unsettling mood fills the air, instantly shaking off the prior sense of unreality.
Shalom glances at her, shifts her gaze to you, offers a faint smile, and releases your hand.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Go on. Your adjutant is waiting. I'll hand you back to her for now.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: There will be plenty of time for us later.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...I appreciate your understanding. Chief, would you kindly follow me, please?
You follow Nightingale out of the confinement cell. Instead of discussing any paperwork, she nervously takes hold of you.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Have you shackled her yet?
Not yet. She's an inspector from Paradeisos, poses a low risk, and doesn't require MBCC's supplementary control. What's wrong?
Nightingale gives a nod, her body remaining taut with tension. She quickly murmurs in a low voice.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...I see.
She is trembling.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: My apologies, I overreacted. She is, indeed, a pivotal figure. Whatever happens, you must pass this <color=#fb9259>trial</color> safely.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Please, don't ask any further questions. I must go.
Nightingale doesn't elaborate on her emotional response and departs hastily.
You pull open a drawer and are met with a cloud of dust.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: The earlier records from the Bureau should all be on this shelf—Cough cough, haven't been cleaned in a while. Cough, it's a bit... disorganized...
Shalom... Paradeisos...
No matter how hard you search, you come up empty-handed.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Yes, we crossed paths at MBCC and engaged meaningfully. You made a lasting impression on me, so perhaps we could be considered more than mere acquaintances—<color=#fb9259>friends</color>, I'd like to think.
Records should be left by anyone who visits, so why is nothing showing up?

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: More files? Oh, right! We've got even more classified stuff here, the kind of legendary tales you only hear whispered about in the Bureau!

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: However, security tightened up after the unrest. Looks like they've sealed off all those juicy files. I can't get at them; I don't have the clearance.
Access Denied. Wynn seems oblivious to your action, meticulously organizing the bookshelf as she casually converses.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: I'm not really well-versed with the documents predating my employment here; I wasn't on board at the time! Huh, now that I think about it, I've only actually encountered Chief in the last few months since joining... What have you been up to all this time?

options: Search for records related to yourself

choices.text: Search for records related to yourself

steps.content: These are MBCC's daily work logs for the past year. Your name doesn't appear anywhere, nor does the title of MBCC Chief.
The role of Chief has been vacant for nearly an entire year, with all official duties managed by the acting supervisor, Nightingale.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>The first time</color> we crossed paths was here, earlier this year, before you lost your memory. Back then, you were a storm of raw emotions, a spectacle of pure, unfiltered feeling. Unyielding, you charged forward without a second thought.
Where were you back then? If you weren't the Chief, then who did Shalom visit? And if it was you, in what capacity?
What was her agenda at that time, and what actions did she take? Now that she's returned, what is she after?
A multitude of questions flood your mind, crystallizing into two pivotal inquiries:
Just who were you before the loss of memory?
And who is this woman who "can't" be shackled?
